name: blog-content-team
description: The blog's agentic content team as data: writer -> editor -> reviewer -> gate -> publisher -> build. Seed a team.Brief (topic/slug/date) and the team drafts, edits, reviews, and publishes a post. Every effect is journaled, so the whole run replays byte-for-byte at $0.

steps.name: writer
steps.description: Role: WRITER. Drafts a post from the brief.
steps.prompt: You are the WRITER on a blog team. Write a focused blog post on this topic: {{team.Brief.topic}}. Tone: {{team.Brief.tone}}. Return ONLY a JSON object {"title": "...", "body": "..."} where body is Markdown (headings, short paragraphs, one code block if it helps). No prose outside the JSON.

steps.name: editor
steps.description: Role: EDITOR. Tightens the draft for clarity, tone, and structure.

steps.name: reviewer
steps.description: Role: REVIEWER. Gates the edited post: approve or send back for revision.

steps.name: gate
steps.description: Route on the reviewer's verdict: approve flows to publish, revise ends the run with notes.

steps.name: publish
steps.description: Role: PUBLISHER. Writes the approved post into site/posts/ as Markdown with front matter.

steps.name: build
steps.description: Role: PUBLISHER. Rebuilds the static site from the Markdown posts.
